status: Candidate routes and evidence requirements for every final S4 residual. This is an investigation plan, not clearance or a claim that every treatment is suitable.

routes.decision: Separate bottom/fly/APC residues; assay soluble salts, metals and organics. Evaluate selective metal extraction, permitted encapsulated products or specialist disposal. Do not reapply a blanket 60% yield repeatedly.
routes.reason_no_credit: No residual assay, leachability/product test or accepted outlet. Existing city initiative is the counterfactual.

routes.decision: Analyze separately from incumbent ash; new fuel can change chemistry. Apply only a demonstrated compatible treatment.
routes.reason_no_credit: No incremental-fuel ash assay or disposal offer.

routes.decision: Metals may be extracted, organic contaminants may be degraded/desorbed/destroyed, and other constituents immobilized. Select by chemistry; track extracted solution, gases, new salts and residues. Fuel use requires actual organic content and acceptance.
routes.reason_no_credit: No contaminant vector, speciation, recoverable metal concentration or complete treatment train.

routes.decision: Treat with process water as appropriate; recover water only with discharge/reuse authorization. Track concentrate, sludge, media, purge and contaminant mass. Internal recycle is not final contaminant destruction.
routes.reason_no_credit: No dissolved contaminant assay, makeup/purge balance or permitted reuse route.

routes.decision: First characterize and subdivide glass/minerals, polymers/textiles, biodegradable organics and hazards. Clean-source organics routes cannot be assumed appropriate for this mixed residue.
routes.reason_no_credit: This is an unknown category, not evidence of any particular recoverable feedstock.

routes.decision: Identify why rejected: chlorine/fluorine, moisture, ash, hazardous content, size or lack of capacity. Drying or conversion is not automatically a solution; include energy, oil/gas refining, char, aqueous and emission controls.
routes.reason_no_credit: No rejection mechanism, feed spec, conversion guarantee or product/refinery contract.

routes.decision: Test additional liberation and concentration versus energy/wear and toll-refining value. Include recovery losses and residues.
routes.reason_no_credit: No particle assay, liberation curve or refinery netback.

routes.decision: Zero only in the annual full-capture envelope. Real intake buffering, outages, authorized fraction and schedules may leave material unprocessed.
routes.reason_no_credit: No validated full-capture logistics or permission.
